risk.rationale: Confirmed account takeover chain for d.yilmaz@aegean.edu: (F1) phishing/spearphishing link delivered from typosquatting domain aegean-edu.co; (F3) valid-account login with impossible travel Amsterdam→Manisa in 234 min; (F2) bulk SIS access (38 events in 60 min from 185.220.101.7); (F5) API-created inbox forwarding rule to external d.yilmaz.payroll@gmail.com. Together these confirm initial access, credential use, data access, and persistence/exfiltration. The rejected password-spray claim (shared NAT background noise) does not undermine the confirmed chain. Meets contain criteria: confirmed ATO chain.
